children: NetApp reported record quarterly net revenues of $2.03 billion for the first quarter of fiscal 2027, up 30% year‑over‑year, with GAAP diluted EPS of $1.88 and record non‑GAAP diluted EPS of $2.58. The company delivered billings of $2.06 billion (up 36% year‑over‑year) and reported GAAP operating margin of 23.9% (non‑GAAP 31.9%). NetApp also announced the acquisition of DataPelago to advance AI data infrastructure capabilities and raised fiscal 2027 revenue and EPS guidance.
Net revenues: $2,025 million (Q1 FY27), up 30% year‑over‑year.
Gross profit: $1,419 million (GAAP); gross margin 70.1% (Q1 FY27).
Income from operations: $484 million (GAAP); operating margin 23.9% (Q1 FY27).
Net income: $375 million (GAAP); diluted earnings per share $1.88 (GAAP).
Non‑GAAP net income: $515 million; non‑GAAP diluted earnings per share $2.58 (record).
All‑flash array revenue reached $1,309 million in the quarter, up 47% year‑over‑year, driving strength in the Hybrid Cloud segment.
Public Cloud net revenue was a record $206 million, up 28% year‑over‑year, reflecting growth in cloud native and cloud services.

Announced strategic product releases and enhancements including StorageGRID 12.1, NetApp Trident 26.06 capabilities for Kubernetes, Azure NetApp Files feature expansions (64 TiB support and Object REST API), and instaclustr MCP Gateway to support AI workloads.

Expanded partner and customer momentum with collaborations and partnerships (Cisco, CGI, SK Telecom, Okestro, Tata Consultancy Services) and proof‑of‑concepts demonstrating AI infrastructure scalability and migration capabilities.
Completed acquisition of DataPelago to bolster AI data infrastructure and appointed Alvaro Celis as Chief Partner and Ecosystem Officer to lead partner ecosystem initiatives.
